privacyPolicy:
This Privacy Policy describes how _COMPANY_ ("we", "us") collects, uses, and shares information when you use the Service at https://_WEBSITE_/ and the embeddable feedback widget.

1. Who this covers. (a) Account holders who sign up for the dashboard. (b) Visitors to our marketing and app pages. (c) End users of your sites who submit feedback through a widget you embed ("End Users"). You are the controller of End User data you collect via the widget; we process it to provide the Service to you.

2. Information we collect.

Account and billing: name, email, password (stored hashed), organization/app settings, public widget keys, origin allowlists, greetings, and similar configuration. Payment card data is handled by Stripe; we receive customer and subscription identifiers and status, not full card numbers.

Customer Content: feedback messages, optional screenshots, page URLs, user agents, app versions, and optional End User identifiers you configure (name, email, id).

Technical data: IP address, browser type, approximate request metadata, cookies for authentication and CSRF protection, and logs needed to operate and secure the Service.

We do not intentionally collect precise geolocation of mobile devices as a product feature.

3. How we use information. To provide and improve the Service; authenticate users; enforce rate limits and security; process payments; communicate about the Service (including security and billing); and comply with law.

4. Legal bases (EEA/UK where applicable). Contract performance, legitimate interests (security, product improvement), consent where required, and legal obligation.

5. Sharing. We share data with infrastructure and service providers who process it on our instructions (for example hosting, payments). We may disclose information if required by law, to protect rights and safety, or in connection with a merger or sale of assets (with notice where required). We do not sell personal information.

6. Widget on your sites. When you embed the widget, End User submissions are sent to our servers under your project key. You are responsible for notices and consents required for your End Users and for configuring allowlists and retention practices appropriate to your use case.

7. Retention. We retain account data while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterward. Submission and screenshot data are retained until you delete them or close the account, subject to backups and legal holds. You may request deletion of account data by contacting _EMAIL_.

8. Security. We use industry-standard measures (including HTTPS, hashed passwords, and access controls). No method of transmission or storage is fully secure.

9. Children. The Service is not directed to children under 13 (or 16 where required). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

10. International transfers. Data may be processed in the United States and other countries where we or our providers operate. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers.

11. Your rights. Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or export personal data, or to object to or restrict certain processing. Contact _EMAIL_. You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

12. Cookies. We use essential cookies for sessions and security. We do not use third-party advertising cookies on the core Service.
